definitions.gloss: to press, to corner, to close in on
definitions.explanation: To approach someone aggressively to press for answers or demand something. Often implies intimidating or confrontational behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{責任者|せきにんしゃ}→責任者：17175_sekininsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: She confronted the person in charge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: Citizens pressed the mayor for an explanation.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ particle for the person being pressed: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (ra-row): {詰|つ}め{寄|よ}らない, {詰|つ}め{寄|よ}ります, {詰|つ}め{寄|よ}って.

NUANCE: {詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る conveys aggressive or confrontational pressing. It often describes reporters surrounding someone, protesters confronting officials, or someone demanding answers in an intimidating manner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る (to press/confront someone)
- ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る (to press for an explanation)
- ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る (reporters close in)
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追及|ついきゅう}して→追及する：21385_tsuikyuu⟧{詰|つ}め{寄|よ}る (to press someone about responsibility)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{問|と}い{詰|つ}める→問い詰める：09147_toitsumeru⟧ (to press for answers - more verbal)
- ⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (to press, approach - more general)
- ⟦{追及|ついきゅう}する→追及する：21385_tsuikyuu⟧ (to pursue, investigate)
